subject: Travel Itinerary Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are excited to confirm your upcoming travel itinerary for your trip to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for [date] at [time] from [airport], and your hotel reservation has been successfully secured at [hotel name]. Please review the attached itinerary for further details. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Warm regards, The Travel Agency Team
